name: PVP-WORDS-mountains-enter-bag-back

new: 'You enter {zone}, an open PvP zone. Foes here are four times as strong. If another player kills you, you drop what you carry.',

name: PVP-WORDS-mountains-chip-bag-back

name: PVP-WORDS-sea-enter-bag-back
old: "You sail out of Veilhaven's peace onto the open {word} Ocean, an open PvP zone. Foes here are four times as strong. If another player kills you, they may take one uninsured worn piece, or gold.",
new: "You sail out of Veilhaven's peace onto the open {word} Ocean, an open PvP zone. Foes here are four times as strong. If another player kills you, you drop what you carry.",

name: PVP-WORDS-kept-line-back
old: deathKept: () => t('wild.death.kept', 'Nothing dropped. You pay the usual death penalty.'), // PVP-WORDS: no bag drops at a kill either
new: deathKept: () => t('wild.death.kept', "Nothing dropped. Only another player's kill drops what you carry."), // PVP-WORDS: no bag drops at a kill either

name: PVP-WORDS-legend-bag-back
old: "If another player kills you, nothing drops. They may take one uninsured worn piece, or gold. Insured gear is kept, but never a villain's.", // PVP-WORDS (PVP-REWARD): no bag drops; the killer's one roll
new: "If another player kills you, what you carry drops and lies there for 10 minutes. Potions, torches, the camp kit, your cart, your companions' packs and insured gear are kept.", // PVP-WORDS (PVP-REWARD): no bag drops; the killer's one roll

name: PVP-WORDS-page-bag-back
old: 'If another player kills you there, nothing drops. They may take one uninsured worn piece, or else one policy\'s gold, or else a tenth of your coin and letters of credit. Any other death costs the usual tenth.'
new: 'If another player kills you there, your bag drops with a tenth of your gold, and they may take one worn item. Your cart, companions\' packs and insured gear are kept. Any other death costs the usual tenth.'

name: PVP-WORDS-claim-line-back
old: deathPvp: (name) => `${name || 'Another player'} may take one uninsured worn piece of yours, or gold.`, // PVP-WORDS: the service's roll
new: deathPvp: (name) => `${name || 'Another player'} may claim one piece of your worn gear.`, // PVP-WORDS: the service's roll
note: the old line back: the killer no longer claims, the service rolls
